name: changelog-flow
description: Zero-dependency CLI that makes releases procedural: feature/release branches, semantic versioning and a Keep a Changelog CHANGELOG, usable by humans and AI agents.
author: ilDon

scripts.test:node: bun run build && CGLG_TEST_RUNTIME=node bun test test/e2e.test.ts
scripts.deploy: bun run build && node out/bin.js release start && npm publish && node out/bin.js release finish
